The PAVM in the upper lobe was embolized with MPV-5Q (Reverse Medical Corporation, Irvine CA, USA) delivered through a microcatheter 2.8 Fr (Renegade Hi-Flo; Boston ScientificMarlborough, MA, USA) with following immediate occlusion of both PAVMs (Fig. 6 a, b). The smaller PAVM in the right lower lobe had two feeding arteries. One feeding artery with a diameter of 3 mm was embolized with a detachable coil 4 mm and 8 cm in length (Interlock, Boston ScientificMarlborough, MA, USA).
